info.title: LeadGen - Consumer

x-seo.description: LeadGen Consumer API by Melissa. Generate consumer leads with demographic and geographic targeting.

info.description:
## LeadGen - Consumer Overview ##
LeadGen Consumer Cloud API offers a real-time REST-based solution, enabling users to select, retrieve counts, and purchase customized consumer mailing lists.

The LeadGen Cloud APIs are at the disposal of mailers, whether for private in-house use or as a customer-facing portal for list selection.

**Documentation**
- [LeadGen Consumer Documentation](https://docs.melissa.com/reference-data/leadgen-consumer/leadgen-consumer-index.html)

**Useful Resources**
- [GitHub - LeadGen Consumer Open API Specification](https://github.com/MelissaData/MelissaCloudAPI-OpenAPI-Specification/blob/main/openapi/apis/leadgen-consumer.yaml)
- [Release notes](https://releasenotes.melissa.com/cloud-api/leadgen-cloud-api/)
- [Status codes](https://docs.melissa.com/other/status-codes-index.html)

**Product Page**

[https://www.melissa.com/direct/mailing-lists-sales-leads/leadgen-api](https://www.melissa.com/direct/mailing-lists-sales-leads/leadgen-api)

**Support Center**

[https://www.melissa.com/company/product-support](https://www.melissa.com/company/product-support)

tags.name: Consumer Service
tags.description: Use Consumer Service endpoint to request various consumer service actions.

get.summary: Perform action for a single consumer
get.description: Uses HTTP GET to accept one input record and returns the response in XML format.

application/xml.example:
<Consumer>
  <Geography>
    <City>CA;orange</City>
  </Geography>
  <Options>
    <ContactPersonInfo>
      <ContactPersonInfo>One per Address</ContactPersonInfo>
      <USPSPreferredCityNames>True</USPSPreferredCityNames>
    </ContactPersonInfo>
    <AdvantageDwellingType>
      <Details>Single Family Only</Details>
    </AdvantageDwellingType>
    <Emails>
      <Details>All Records</Details>
    </Emails>
    <ContactAgeGroup>
      <Details>26-30; 31-35; 36-40</Details>
    </ContactAgeGroup>
    <HomeOwnerRenter>
      <Details>Home Owner</Details>
    </HomeOwnerRenter>
  </Options>
  <CountDetails>
    <StreetRange>
      <Street>
        <StartNumber />
        <EndNumber />
        <Geography>Orange, CA</Geography>
        <Zip />
        <Count>3172</Count>
      </Street>
    </StreetRange>
  </CountDetails>
  <TotalCount>
    <Count>3172</Count>
  </TotalCount>
  <Result>
    <StatusCode>Approved</StatusCode>
  </Result>
</Consumer>

post.summary: Check order (file) status after a buy request
post.description: Uses HTTP POST to accept a URL or OrderId and returns the File Status response in JSON format.

Action.name: action
Action.description: There are two available actions: get and buy. get: Get count of addresses that fit in the given criteria. buy: Buy a list of addresses' info that fit the given criteria.

GeographicType.name: geographicType
GeographicType.description: The included [Geographic Types](https://docs.melissa.com/reference-data/leadgen-business/leadgen-business-reference-guide.html#geographic-types) are zip, city, county, state, radius, circle, and polygon.

CustomerID.name: id
CustomerID.description: Customer ID, [License Key](https://docs.melissa.com/melissa/license/license-information.html), or Email Address. This is checked against the list of registered customers.

Zip.name: zip
Zip.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: zip
* Optional: radius

Handling: Each five-digit ZIP is validated.

ZipPlus4.name: zip+4
ZipPlus4.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: zip
* Optional: radius

Handling: Plus4 is a filter in data selection.

City.name: city
City.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: city
* Optional: radius

Handling: Each city and state combination is valid

County.name: county
County.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: county

Handling: Each county and state combination is validated. FIPS is retrieved if valid.

State.name: state
State.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: state
* Optional: radius

Handling: Two-digit state code is validated.

Address.name: addr
Address.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: radius

Handling: Exact street number and street name are used in data selection. No validation. Latitude and longitude are retrieved if the address exists.

Mile.name: mile
Mile.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: circle
* Optional: radius
(Mile or record must be given.)

Handling: Mile is used to find out the latitude and longitude of a parameter for many miles away from the given address. For radius type, maximum is 50 miles. For circle type, the radius must be between .025 and 25 miles

Records.name: records
Records.description:
Geographic Type
* Optional: radius
(Mile or record must be given.)

Handling: Number of records that are closest to the given address

Street.name: str
Street.description:
Geographic Type
* Optional: radius

Handling: A street name within the given zip. (The street name needs to be exact.)

StreetZip.name: strzip
StreetZip.description:
Geographic Type
* Optional: radius

Handling: Zip for a specific street that is within the given radius (combination with a given address.)

Point.name: pt
Point.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: circle

Handling: A longitude;latitude point

Points.name: points
Points.description:
Geographic Type
* Required: polygon

Handling: Each set of points for a polygon is validated and reoriented in the sequence of drawing.
